Apply weights matrix by determining what counts as a neighbor. What are the methods?

1.  Contiguity: Rook vs Queen: Queen includes diagonal

Local Moran's I is one house at a timee. will be standardised. Calculate by

1.  Multiply value \* avg of neighbor's value (aka spatial lag)

LISA interpretation (ME-NEIGHBOURS)

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------+
|                                                                             |                            |
+=============================================================================+============================+
| **HH**                                                                      | **HL**                     |
|                                                                             |                            |
| High value, High neighbours (aka mean value of neighbours, aka spatial lag) | High value, Low neighbours |
|                                                                             |                            |
| Pocket of underprediction                                                   |                            |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------+
| **LH**                                                                      | **LL**                     |
|                                                                             |                            |
| Low value, High neighbours                                                  | Low value, Low neighbours  |
|                                                                             |                            |
|                                                                             | Pocket of overprediction   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------+

- HH and LL clusters – hotspot and low spots → extract and put on a map

- HL and LH are outliers. 

Code

1.  nb2listw(style = "W")

    1.  W = all neighbours get equl weight regardless of value/frequency

2.  Define LISA function to get HH, HL, LL, LH

    1.  perm = permutations, to randomise values all over the map
    2.  lag = spatial lag from avg of neighbours
    3.  p = significance value
    4.  z = spatial error. (residual - mean(residual))

    - If z\>0 and lag\>0:: HH

    - If z\>0 and lag\<0: HL

    - If z\<0 and lag\<0: LL

    - If z\<0 and lag\>0: LH
